<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#071326">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="64x64" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="shortcut icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<meta name="alley-cloud-version" content="1.1.4">
<meta name="description" content="ALLEY Cloud — NANO AI, Raspberry Pi access, and personal website hosting in one workspace.">
<title>ALLEY Cloud — Your AI. Your Pi. Your corner of the web.</title>
<style>
:root{
 --ink:#0b1730;--ink-2:#152746;--muted:#66748d;--muted-light:#aab7cc;--blue:#3499dc;--blue-2:#63c3f6;--cyan:#80d7ef;--pink:#f3a1dc;--violet:#b9a0f5;--gold:#ffd5a2;--paper:#f5f8fd;--white:#fff;--line:#e4eaf3;--green:#44c6a1;--shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(8,25,55,.12);--radius:24px;
}
#view-home,
#view-home *{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:90px}
#view-home{margin:0;font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
#view-home a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
#view-home button,
#view-home input,
#view-home textarea{font:inherit}
#view-home button,
#view-home a{tap-highlight-color:transparent}
#view-home button{cursor:pointer}
#view-home button:focus-visible,
#view-home a:focus-visible,
#view-home input:focus-visible,
#view-home textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #83cdf7;outline-offset:3px}
#view-home .container{width:min(1160px,calc(100% - 44px));margin-inline:auto}
#view-home .gradient-text{background:linear-gradient(105deg,var(--pink) 0%,var(--violet) 35%,var(--gold) 53%,var(--cyan) 76%,#68bdf1 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
#view-home .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;color:#6baee3}
#view-home .eyebrow .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(68,198,161,.12)}
#view-home .btn{border:0;border-radius:13px;padding:13px 19px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;font-weight:750;font-size:.92rem;transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,background .18s ease;white-space:nowrap}
#view-home .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
#view-home .btn-primary{color:#07172d;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#f5a5df,#c5a9ff 35%,#8bdaf5 100%);box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(123,193,239,.22)}
#view-home .btn-primary:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(123,193,239,.34)}
#view-home .btn-light{color:var(--ink);background:#fff;box-shadow:0 9px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
#view-home .btn-outline{border:1px solid rgba(170,190,221,.32);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:#f5f8ff}
#view-home .btn-outline:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
#view-home .btn-dark{background:var(--ink);color:white}
#view-home .btn-small{padding:10px 14px;font-size:.86rem}
#view-home .icon{width:20px;height:20px;display:inline-block;flex:none}
#view-home .topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(8,19,38,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
#view-home .nav{height:76px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;color:#fff}
#view-home .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:max-content}
#view-home .brand-mark{width:48px;height:42px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 10px rgba(45,150,220,.18))}
#view-home .brand-name{font-size:1.32rem;letter-spacing:-.055em;font-weight:900}
#view-home .nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:29px;color:#c2cde0;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600}
#view-home .nav-links a:hover{color:#fff}
#view-home .nav-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px}
#view-home .login-link{color:#dbe5f3;font-weight:650;font-size:.88rem;padding:9px}
#view-home .menu-toggle{display:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:12px;background:transparent;color:white;width:42px;height:42px}
#view-home .hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 35%,rgba(39,118,191,.22),transparent 34%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 12% 80%,rgba(179,118,208,.1),transparent 28%),#081326;color:white;padding:90px 0 86px}
#view-home .hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.18;pointer-events:none;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.055) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.055) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:56px 56px;mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000,transparent 85%)}
#view-home .hero-glow{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(1px);pointer-events:none;border:1px solid rgba(109,190,237,.11)}
#view-home .glow-one{width:500px;height:500px;right:-115px;top:-190px;box-shadow:0 0 90px rgba(67,151,224,.08) inset}
#view-home .glow-two{width:280px;height:280px;left:44%;bottom:-195px;box-shadow:0 0 75px rgba(205,151,239,.05) inset}
#view-home .hero-grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.03fr .97fr;align-items:center;gap:64px}
#view-home .hero-copy{max-width:640px}
#view-home .hero .eyebrow{color:#91c9f2}
#view-home .hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.85rem,5.1vw,4.8rem);line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.068em;margin:22px 0 24px;font-weight:850}
#view-home .hero p.lede{font-size:1.13rem;color:#b7c4d8;max-width:580px;line-height:1.8;margin:0 0 30px}
#view-home .hero-buttons{display:flex;gap:13px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#view-home .tiny-note{font-size:.78rem;color:#91a2bc;margin-top:18px}
#view-home .tiny-note strong{color:#ced8e8}
#view-home .hero-proof{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;margin-top:38px;color:#a9bad1;font-size:.82rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
#view-home .proof-item{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
#view-home .check-bullet{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(69,198,160,.14);color:#72d7b6;font-size:.73rem;font-weight:900}
#view-home .hero-visual{position:relative;min-width:0}
#view-home .visual-halo{position:absolute;inset:5% -6% 0 0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(65,156,223,.24),transparent 65%);filter:blur(28px);pointer-events:none}
#view-home .workspace{position:relative;border:1px solid rgba(179,204,238,.22);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(24,44,76,.96),rgba(11,26,49,.97));border-radius:25px;padding:19px;box-shadow:0 35px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.32);transform:perspective(1200px) rotateY(-4deg) rotateX(2deg)}
#view-home .workspace-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);padding:0 0 15px;margin-bottom:15px;gap:10px}
#view-home .workspace-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:#f3f7fe;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:750}
#view-home .mini-mark{width:28px;height:25px;object-fit:contain}
#view-home .status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:#91d9bf;font-size:.72rem;background:rgba(68,198,161,.1);border:1px solid rgba(68,198,161,.2);padding:6px 9px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap}
#view-home .status i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:100%;background:#54d6a8}
#view-home .workspace-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
#view-home .dash-card{min-width:0;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border-radius:15px;padding:14px}
#view-home .dash-card.full{grid-column:1/-1}
#view-home .dash-label{font-size:.68rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#90a5c4;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
#view-home .dash-label svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:#8acbf5}
#view-home .dash-title{font-size:.96rem;font-weight:750;color:#f2f6ff;margin:9px 0 6px}
#view-home .dash-sub{font-size:.75rem;color:#9eafc7;line-height:1.5}
#view-home .chat-line{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:13px}
#view-home .chat-avatar{width:25px;height:25px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#f1a3db,#80c9f7);font-size:.63rem;color:#081326;font-weight:900;flex:none}
#view-home .chat-bubble{background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);padding:9px 10px;border-radius:10px;color:#ced9eb;font-size:.73rem;line-height:1.55}
#view-home .dash-stat{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:baseline;margin:11px 0 6px;color:#dbe5f4;font-size:.76rem}
#view-home .dash-stat strong{font-size:.81rem;color:white}
#view-home .meter{height:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
#view-home .meter span{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#b5a5f5,#76d0ec)}
#view-home .domain-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:10px}
#view-home .domain-name{font-size:.82rem;color:#e3ebf7;font-weight:700;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#view-home .domain-pill{font-size:.67rem;color:#92d7c0;border:1px solid rgba(68,198,161,.25);border-radius:7px;padding:4px 7px;white-space:nowrap}
#view-home .terminal-mini{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;color:#a4e5cb;font-size:.76rem;margin-top:12px;white-space:nowrap}
#view-home .terminal-mini b{color:#8dcdf7;font-weight:600}
#view-home .floating-tag{position:absolute;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);padding:11px 14px;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 15px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.22);display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800}
#view-home .floating-tag .tag-icon{height:34px;width:34px;border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#eaf6ff;color:#2087c8}
#view-home .floating-tag small{display:block;color:#74839a;font-size:.67rem;font-weight:600;margin-top:1px}
#view-home .tag-ai{right:-21px;top:-27px}
#view-home .tag-pi{left:-30px;bottom:37px}
#view-home .section{padding:92px 0}
#view-home .section-soft{background:var(--paper)}
#view-home .section-dark{background:#0c1930;color:white}
#view-home .section-head{max-width:710px;margin:0 auto 47px;text-align:center}
#view-home .section-head h2{font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4vw,3.2rem);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.055em;margin:15px 0 17px;font-weight:850}
#view-home .section-head p{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.02rem;margin:0;line-height:1.8}
#view-home .section-dark .section-head p{color:#a9b8cd}
#view-home .feature-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
#view-home .feature-card{padding:27px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(12,34,70,.035);transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
#view-home .feature-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(12,34,70,.08)}
#view-home .feature-icon{width:51px;height:51px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:16px;margin-bottom:22px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f6d8ef,#e9e0ff 52%,#d6f4ff);color:#1e5f91}
#view-home .feature-icon svg{width:24px;height:24px}
#view-home .feature-card h3{font-size:1.18rem;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:0 0 10px}
#view-home .feature-card p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75;margin:0 0 17px}
#view-home .text-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:800;font-size:.85rem;color:#287eb8}
#view-home .text-link:hover{gap:12px}
#view-home .demo-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:42px;align-items:center}
#view-home .demo-copy h2{font-size:clamp(2.05rem,4vw,3.1rem);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.055em;margin:16px 0}
#view-home .demo-copy p{color:#a8b9d0;line-height:1.8}
#view-home .benefit-list{display:grid;gap:14px;padding:0;margin:24px 0 0;list-style:none}
#view-home .benefit-list li{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:11px;color:#d4deed;font-size:.91rem}
#view-home .benefit-list .check-bullet{margin-top:2px;flex:none}
#view-home .demo-panel{background:#0a1427;border:1px solid rgba(165,195,231,.2);border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 25px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
#view-home .panel-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);background:rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
#view-home .window-dots{display:flex;gap:6px}
#view-home .window-dots span{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:100%;background:#43546c}
#view-home .window-dots span:first-child{background:#f59f9b}
#view-home .window-dots span:nth-child(2){background:#f5d58b}
#view-home .window-dots span:nth-child(3){background:#6fd7ae}
#view-home .panel-title{color:#93a5bf;font-size:.75rem;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace}
#view-home .demo-chat{height:270px;overflow:auto;padding:19px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
#view-home .message{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;max-width:95%}
#view-home .message.user{margin-left:auto;flex-direction:row-reverse}
#view-home .message .message-icon{width:28px;height:28px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:9px;flex:none;background:rgba(124,198,243,.13);color:#8ccff8;font-weight:900;font-size:.68rem}
#view-home .message.user .message-icon{background:rgba(229,167,219,.15);color:#f0b2df}
#view-home .message-text{background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:3px 12px 12px 12px;padding:10px 12px;color:#ccd7e8;font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.65}
#view-home .message.user .message-text{background:rgba(126,187,239,.12);border-color:rgba(126,187,239,.15);border-radius:12px 3px 12px 12px;color:#e3efff}
#view-home .chat-form{padding:13px 14px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-end}
#view-home .chat-form textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:43px;max-height:100px;flex:1;min-width:0;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:white;padding:11px 12px;font-size:.84rem}
#view-home .chat-form textarea::placeholder{color:#7588a5}
#view-home .send-btn{width:44px;height:43px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#eaa6e1,#9baff7 48%,#8cdaee);color:#07172d}
#view-home .demo-disclaimer{color:#8294ae;font-size:.72rem;padding:0 17px 15px}
#view-home .pi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:stretch}
#view-home .pi-info,
#view-home .pi-terminal{border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden}
#view-home .pi-info{padding:30px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line)}
#view-home .pi-info h3{font-size:1.35rem;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:12px 0}
#view-home .pi-info p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75;font-size:.91rem}
#view-home .pi-perks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:24px}
#view-home .pi-perk{padding:14px;border-radius:14px;background:#f5f8fd}
#view-home .pi-perk strong{display:block;font-size:.83rem}
#view-home .pi-perk span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem;margin-top:3px}
#view-home .pi-terminal{background:#081326;color:#d5e3f4;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border:1px solid #142642;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#view-home .term-top{padding:17px 19px;border-bottom:1px solid #1d2d49;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
#view-home .term-title{font-weight:750;font-size:.88rem}
#view-home .term-chip{font-size:.69rem;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 8px;color:#91d8c0;background:rgba(68,198,161,.1)}
#view-home .term-body{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:.8rem;line-height:2;min-height:235px;padding:19px;flex:1}
#view-home .term-line{display:block;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#view-home .term-prompt{color:#91d9ba}
#view-home .term-command{color:#9ecff8}
#view-home .term-output{color:#9baec9}
#view-home .term-input-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 14px;border-top:1px solid #1d2d49}
#view-home .term-input-row input{flex:1;min-width:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid #253754;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;color:white;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:.78rem}
#view-home .term-input-row button{border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 13px;background:#192e4e;color:#d9eaff;font-weight:750;font-size:.76rem}
#view-home .term-footnote{font-size:.71rem;color:#7f91ad;padding:0 17px 14px}
#view-home .webhost-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.93fr 1.07fr;gap:40px;align-items:center}
#view-home .webhost-layout .section-copy h2{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4vw,3.2rem);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:16px 0}
#view-home .section-copy p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8}
#view-home .site-preview{border-radius:24px;background:white;border:1px solid #e1e8f2;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 25px 65px rgba(27,55,95,.12);transform:rotate(1deg)}
#view-home .preview-bar{height:43px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0 15px;background:#f7f9fc;border-bottom:1px solid #e8edf5}
#view-home .preview-bar span{height:7px;width:7px;background:#d7dfeb;border-radius:50%}
#view-home .preview-url{font-size:.68rem;color:#91a0b4;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8edf4;border-radius:6px;margin-left:8px;padding:3px 12px;flex:1;text-align:center}
#view-home .preview-page{padding:25px 27px 28px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fff,#f7fbff)}
#view-home .preview-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.7rem;color:#62708a;font-weight:800}
#view-home .preview-logo{font-size:.87rem;color:#142543;letter-spacing:-.04em}
#view-home .preview-hero{padding:37px 0 28px;max-width:390px}
#view-home .preview-kicker{color:#258cc8;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.58rem;font-weight:900}
#view-home .preview-hero h3{font-size:2.15rem;line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.065em;margin:10px 0;color:#10213c}
#view-home .preview-hero p{color:#7b8aa3;font-size:.76rem;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 16px;max-width:280px}
#view-home .preview-action{display:inline-block;background:#152847;color:white;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:7px;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:800}
#view-home .preview-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:9px}
#view-home .preview-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #eaf0f7;border-radius:10px;padding:11px}
#view-home .preview-card .preview-icon{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:7px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f4b4df,#a5dff8);margin-bottom:10px}
#view-home .preview-card strong{display:block;font-size:.65rem}
#view-home .preview-card small{display:block;color:#91a0b3;font-size:.58rem;margin-top:4px}
#view-home .hosting-note{margin-top:17px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.77rem;color:#6d7c92}
#view-home .hosting-note svg{color:#2f98d4;flex:none}
#view-home .pricing-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;margin-bottom:29px}
#view-home .pricing-top .section-head{margin:0;text-align:left}
#view-home .pricing-top .section-head h2{font-size:clamp(2.15rem,4vw,3.15rem)}
#view-home .billing-toggle{flex:none;border-radius:13px;background:#edf2f9;padding:5px;display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center}
#view-home .billing-toggle button{border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 12px;font-weight:750;color:#78869c;font-size:.8rem}
#view-home .billing-toggle button.active{background:white;color:#142340;box-shadow:0 2px 9px rgba(21,42,78,.08)}
#view-home .save-tag{font-size:.65rem;color:#188e71;font-weight:800;margin-left:4px}
#view-home .pricing-note{font-size:.76rem;color:#8794a7;margin:-12px 0 24px}
#view-home .pricing-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;align-items:stretch}
#view-home .plan{border:1px solid #dfe6f0;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;padding:22px 17px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;position:relative;transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
#view-home .plan:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(17,40,77,.09)}
#view-home .plan.featured{border:2px solid #65bdea;box-shadow:0 13px 40px rgba(77,165,220,.15);padding:21px 16px 17px}

/* Single-file application shell and route visibility */
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body { margin:0; min-height:100vh; background:#fff; }
.spa-view { display:none !important; min-height:100vh; }
.spa-view.active { display:block !important; }
#view-home { background:#fff; color:#0b1730; }
#view-login,#view-signup,#view-account,#view-gate {
  min-height:100vh;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 15%,rgba(67,153,220,.18),transparent 37%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 80%,rgba(182,139,242,.12),transparent 32%),#071326;
  color:#eef5ff;
}


/* Business plan customizer */
#view-home .business-plan-note{color:#8a96aa;font-size:.64rem;line-height:1.5;margin:12px 0 0}
#view-home .price.custom-price{font-size:1.95rem;letter-spacing:-.055em}
#view-home .business-customizer-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:22px;background:rgba(7,17,35,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#view-home .business-customizer-overlay[hidden]{display:none!important}
#view-home .business-customizer-dialog{width:min(880px,100%);max-height:min(90vh,900px);overflow:auto;position:relative;padding:clamp(24px,4vw,38px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8);border-radius:27px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff 0%,#f3f8ff 100%);box-shadow:0 35px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
#view-home .business-customizer-close{position:absolute;right:17px;top:14px;border:1px solid #dfe7f1;border-radius:50%;width:38px;height:38px;background:#fff;color:#172b49;font-size:1.5rem;cursor:pointer}
#view-home .business-customizer-dialog h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.5rem);letter-spacing:-.05em;line-height:1.1;margin:14px 45px 10px 0;color:#172943}
#view-home .business-customizer-intro{max-width:680px;font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.75;color:#718099;margin:0 0 24px}
#view-home .business-customizer-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.45fr) minmax(220px,.75fr);gap:20px;align-items:start}
#view-home .business-addon-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}
#view-home .business-addon{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;border:1px solid #e0e8f2;border-radius:15px;padding:13px 12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.84);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease}
#view-home .business-addon:has(input:checked){border-color:#65bdea;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(101,189,234,.14)}
#view-home .business-addon input{margin:4px 0 0;accent-color:#2489c8;flex:none;width:16px;height:16px}
#view-home .business-addon span{display:grid;gap:4px;min-width:0}
#view-home .business-addon strong{font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.4;color:#172943}
#view-home .business-addon small{font-size:.68rem;line-height:1.45;color:#7b889d}
#view-home .business-addon em{font-size:.72rem;font-style:normal;font-weight:800;color:#2489c8;margin-top:2px}
#view-home .business-estimate-card{position:sticky;top:0;padding:22px;border:1px solid #d7e7f6;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#102542,#1b4267);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(20,59,98,.17)}
#view-home .business-estimate-label{color:#a9d8f7;font-size:.73rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
#view-home .business-estimate-value{font-size:2.7rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.07em;line-height:1.1;margin:12px 0}
#view-home .business-estimate-value span{font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:0;font-weight:600;color:#b5c9df;margin-left:5px}
#view-home #businessEstimateNote{font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.6;color:#d2e1f0;min-height:50px}
#view-home #businessContinue{width:100%;margin:13px 0 10px;padding:12px 10px;white-space:normal}
#view-home .business-estimate-disclaimer{font-size:.66rem;line-height:1.6;color:#a9bed4;margin:0}
@media(max-width:740px){#view-home .business-customizer-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}#view-home .business-estimate-card{position:static}#view-home .business-addon-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:520px){#view-home .business-customizer-overlay{align-items:flex-end;padding:0}#view-home .business-customizer-dialog{width:100%;max-height:94vh;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;padding:26px 18px 22px}#view-home .business-customizer-dialog h2{font-size:1.8rem}#view-home .business-customizer-close{right:12px;top:12px}}


/* NANO AI identity */
.nano-ai-logo{display:block;object-fit:contain;flex:none;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;}
#view-home .feature-icon .nano-ai-logo{width:51px;height:51px;border-radius:16px;}
#view-home .nano-ai-inline-logo{width:29px;height:29px;margin-right:2px;border-radius:50%;}
#view-home .chat-avatar .nano-ai-chat-mark{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;}
#view-account .nano-ai-tile-logo{width:42px;height:42px;display:grid;place-items:center;object-fit:contain;border-radius:13px;background:#fff;}
#view-account .nano-ai-tile-logo .nano-ai-logo{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;border-radius:13px;}

/* Detailed plan view */
#view-home .plan[data-plan]{cursor:pointer}
#view-home .plan[data-plan]:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #63b9e8;outline-offset:4px}
#view-home .plan-detail-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1100;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:22px;background:rgba(7,17,35,.76);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#view-home .plan-detail-overlay[hidden]{display:none!important}
#view-home .plan-detail-dialog{width:min(760px,100%);max-height:min(90vh,860px);overflow:auto;position:relative;padding:clamp(24px,4vw,38px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-radius:27px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff 0%,#f4f8ff 100%);box-shadow:0 35px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.34);color:#152540}
#view-home .plan-detail-close{position:absolute;right:18px;top:16px;width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid #dbe4f0;border-radius:13px;background:#fff;color:#243754;font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
#view-home .plan-detail-kicker{font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.13em;font-weight:850;color:#399bd3;margin-bottom:10px}
#view-home .plan-detail-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:22px;padding-right:30px}
#view-home .plan-detail-heading h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,2.8rem);letter-spacing:-.065em;line-height:1.05;margin:0 0 10px}
#view-home .plan-detail-heading p{margin:0;color:#718097;line-height:1.65;max-width:470px}
#view-home .plan-detail-price{flex:none;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #dce9f7;border-radius:16px;background:#f5faff;font-weight:900;font-size:1.15rem;white-space:nowrap}
#view-home .plan-detail-price small{display:block;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:650;color:#7e8da3;margin-top:3px}
#view-home .plan-detail-section{margin-top:27px;padding:20px;border:1px solid #e0e8f2;border-radius:19px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.82)}
#view-home .plan-detail-section h3{font-size:1rem;margin:0 0 13px}
#view-home .plan-detail-features{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px 18px}
#view-home .plan-detail-features li{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;color:#42546e;font-size:.89rem;line-height:1.5}
#view-home .plan-detail-features li:before{content:'✓';display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:7px;background:#e2f7f0;color:#138769;font-weight:900;font-size:.76rem;margin-top:1px}
#view-home .plan-detail-note{margin:14px 0 0;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:#f0f5fb;color:#697a92;font-size:.76rem;line-height:1.6}
#view-home .plan-detail-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:23px}
#view-home .plan-detail-actions .btn{min-width:160px}
#view-home .plan-detail-actions .btn-outline{border:1px solid #d3deed;background:#fff;color:#213550}
#view-home .plan-detail-actions .btn-outline:hover{background:#f0f6fc}

/* Secure owner promo-code panel */
#view-account .promo-panel{margin:0 0 24px;padding:24px;border:1px solid rgba(95,160,220,.24);border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(45,139,202,.09),rgba(143,119,218,.08)),#fff;box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(13,38,76,.07)}

/* Promo entry is intentionally placed inside the pricing section. */

<section class="section section-soft" id="network-setup">
 <div class="container">
  <div class="section-head"><div class="eyebrow"><span class="dot"></span> Proxy &amp; VPN deployment</div><h2>Run your private gateway on a Raspberry Pi.</h2><p>A static GitHub Pages website cannot run a VPN or proxy itself. This owner test gateway runs WireGuard and an authenticated Squid proxy on a Raspberry Pi 4/5 with Raspberry Pi OS 64-bit.</p></div>
  <div class="network-connect-panel" style="max-width:900px;margin:0 auto">
   <h2>Personal Raspberry Pi test gateway</h2>
   <p>The installer creates a real IPv4 WireGuard tunnel and a password-protected HTTP proxy. Squid listens only on the private VPN address, not the public internet.</p>
   <div class="network-connect-grid">
    <article class="network-connect-card"><h3>1. Prepare your Pi</h3><p>Use Raspberry Pi OS 64-bit (Bookworm or Trixie), update it, connect it to your router, and reserve a fixed LAN IP for the Pi.</p></article>
    <article class="network-connect-card"><h3>2. Check public reachability</h3><p>Your home connection needs a public IPv4 address. Compare your router's WAN IPv4 with <code>curl -4 https://api.ipify.org</code>. If the router is behind CGNAT, normal port forwarding will not work.</p></article>
    <article class="network-connect-card"><h3>3. Forward WireGuard</h3><p>Forward <strong>UDP 51820</strong> from your router to the Pi's reserved LAN IP. Do not forward TCP 3128; the proxy must remain reachable only inside the VPN.</p></article>
    <article class="network-connect-card"><h3>4. Install and connect</h3><p>Run <code>sudo bash install-alley-pi-gateway.sh</code> on the Pi. Import the generated <code>alley-owner.conf</code> into the official WireGuard app. Connect WireGuard first, then configure your HTTP proxy to <code>10.77.0.1:3128</code>.</p></article>
   </div>
   <p class="network-connect-foot">This is a one-owner IPv4 test gateway, not automatic multi-customer provisioning. The website cannot detect whether the tunnel is connected. IPv6 is not tunnelled by this starter, so do not advertise it as a complete privacy VPN until IPv6 routing/leak protection and customer provisioning are implemented.</p>
   <p style="margin-top:10px"><a class="text-link" href="https://www.wireguard.com/install/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Get the official WireGuard app ↗</a></p>
  </div>
 </div>
</section>
<section class="section" id="faq"><div class="container faq-grid"><div class="faq-intro"><div class="eyebrow"><span class="dot"></span> Good questions</div><h2>Clear answers, before you dive in.</h2><p>ALLEY Cloud is designed around tools you control. Here are the key things to know about the concept and what a live service needs behind the scenes.</p><a class="text-link" data-auth-gate="true" href="#/gate?intent=start&amp;feature=ALLEY%20Cloud">Ready to get started? <span>→</span></a></div><div class="faq-list">
<details class="faq-item"><summary>Is NANO AI live yet?</summary><p>This downloaded website is a front-end demo with sample replies. Making NANO AI live requires a server-side AI endpoint, securely managed provider credentials, usage limits, and error handling. Never place a production API key in browser JavaScript.</p></details>
<details class="faq-item"><summary>Can ALLEY Cloud really SSH into my Raspberry Pi?</summary><p>Not from this static page. A real implementation needs an authenticated backend or private tunnel, careful SSH key handling, device authorization, and access controls. The terminal shown here is simulated and never connects to a device.</p></details>
<details class="faq-item"><summary>Will the website be hosted on my Raspberry Pi?</summary><p>That is the intended use case: your Pi can serve your own site, while the service helps with setup and domain routing. Public hosting from home depends on uptime, bandwidth, router/ISP restrictions, TLS, and a secure networking design.</p></details>
<details class="faq-item"><summary>Do I get a domain with a paid plan?</summary><p>Free is demo-only. Plus proposes one IP/domain endpoint; Pro and Ultra propose one custom domain. Domain provisioning and DNS/IP routing need to be connected to a real backend before launch.</p></details>
<details class="faq-item"><summary>How many Linux servers are included?</summary><p>Every paid plan—Plus, Pro, Ultra, and Business—includes one Linux server intended for SSH access. Free is demo-only and does not provision a server. In this prototype the server is a planned feature: a secure provisioning and SSH gateway backend must be built before connections are live.</p></details><details class="faq-item"><summary>How does Business pricing work?</summary><p>Business starts at $5/month. Choose optional AI capacity, website projects, Pi connections, storage, team tools, priority support, or dedicated deployment in the plan customizer. Configurations can range from $5 to $100+ per month; plans above $100 require a final custom quote. The on-page total is only a demo estimate.</p></details><details class="faq-item"><summary>Which plans include Proxy and VPN?</summary><p>Proxy and VPN are available as standalone Plus, Pro, Ultra, or Business feature subscriptions. Their capacity, regions, throughput, and usage rules must be defined before launch. They are planned features and are not active services yet.</p></details><details class="faq-item"><summary>Are these prices and limits final?</summary><p>No. They are illustrative feature-subscription prices and limits. Validate NANO AI provider costs, domain costs, support needs, storage requirements, proxy/VPN infrastructure, server resources, and the real limits of the Raspberry Pi connection service before launch.</p></details>
</div></div></section>

      <ul class="feature-detail-points" id="featureDetailBenefits"></ul>
    </section>
    <section class="feature-detail-columns">
      <article class="feature-detail-panel"><h2>How it works</h2><ul class="feature-detail-bullets" id="featureDetailHow"></ul></article>
      <article class="feature-detail-panel"><h2>What you need</h2><ul class="feature-detail-bullets" id="featureDetailNeeds"></ul></article>
    </section>
    <section class="feature-tier-section">
      <div class="feature-tier-heading"><div><h2>Subscription options</h2><p id="featureDetailTierIntro">Choose the tier that fits your needs.</p></div></div>
      <div class="feature-tier-grid" id="featureDetailTiers"></div>
      <p class="feature-detail-disclaimer" id="featureDetailDisclaimer"></p>
    </section>
  </main>
  <footer class="feature-detail-footer"><span>© <span data-current-year></span> ALLEY Cloud · Feature information</span><a href="#/home?scroll=plans">View all subscriptions ↑</a></footer>
</section>

<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const views = ['home','login','signup','account','gate','feature'];
  const keys = ['alleyCloudDemoSignedIn','alleyCloudDemoEmail','alleyCloudDemoName','alleyCloudDemoPlan','alleyCloudDemoFeature'];
  const safe = (v, max=100) => String(v || '').replace(/[<>]/g, '').slice(0, max);
  // Store display metadata and selected-plan preferences only; Supabase Auth persists the actual session. Never store passwords.
  const readSession = (k, fallback='') => { try { return localStorage.getItem(k) || sessionStorage.getItem(k) || fallback; } catch (_) { return fallback; } };
  const writeSession = (k,v) => { try { localStorage.setItem(k,String(v)); } catch (_) {} };
  const removeSession = (k) => { try { localStorage.removeItem(k); sessionStorage.removeItem(k); } catch (_) {} };
  function getRoute() {
    const h = location.hash || '';
    if (!h.startsWith('#/')) return {view:'home', params:new URLSearchParams(), scroll:h.startsWith('#') ? h.slice(1) : ''};
    const u = new URL('https://alley.local/' + h.slice(2));
    let view = u.pathname.replace(/^\//,'') || 'home';
    if (!views.includes(view)) view = 'home';
    return {view, params:u.searchParams, scroll:u.searchParams.get('scroll') || ''};
  }
  function go(view, params={}, replace=false) {
    const q = new URLSearchParams();
    Object.entries(params || {}).forEach(([k,v]) => { if (v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v) !== '') q.set(k,String(v)); });
    const hash = '#/' + view + (q.size ? '?' + q.toString() : '');
    if (location.hash === hash) render();
    else if (replace) history.replaceState(null,'',hash);
    else location.hash = hash;
  }
  function sharedParams(route) {
    const q = route.params;
    return {
      plan: safe(q.get('plan') || readSession('alleyCloudDemoPlan','Free'),48),
      feature: safe(q.get('feature') || readSession('alleyCloudDemoFeature',''),80),
      intent: safe(q.get('intent') || 'start',24)
    };
  }
  function routeHref(view, extras={}) {
    const r=getRoute(), p=sharedParams(r), out={plan:p.plan,feature:p.feature,intent:p.intent,...extras};
    if (String(out.plan).toLowerCase()==='free' && view!=='gate') delete out.plan;
    Object.keys(out).forEach(k=>{ if (!out[k]) delete out[k]; });
    const q=new URLSearchParams(out);
    return '#/'+view+(q.size?'?'+q.toString():'');
  }
  function updateYears(root) {
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-current-year], #year').forEach(el => el.textContent = new Date().getFullYear());
  }
  function configureGate(route) {
    const root=document.getElementById('view-gate'), p=sharedParams(route);
    const title=root.querySelector('#gateTitle'), subtitle=root.querySelector('#gateSubtitle'), message=root.querySelector('#gateMessage'), reason=root.querySelector('#gateReason'), chip=root.querySelector('#gateChip');
    const descriptions={buy:'Before choosing a plan, create a free account or log in. Your selected plan will carry through to your dashboard.',learn:'Create a free account or log in to continue to this feature.',use:'Sign up or log in before using this workspace tool.',contact:'Create an account or log in so your support request can be associated with a workspace.',dashboard:'Sign in to open your ALLEY Cloud dashboard.',start:'Create a free account or log in to continue.'};
    const headlines={buy:'Choose your plan',learn:'Unlock more details',use:'Your workspace is waiting',contact:'Let’s get you connected',dashboard:'Your dashboard is private',start:'Continue to ALLEY Cloud'};
    if(title) title.textContent=headlines[p.intent]||headlines.start;
    if(subtitle) subtitle.textContent=p.feature?'Requested: '+p.feature:'Account required';
    if(message) message.textContent=descriptions[p.intent]||descriptions.start;
    if(reason) reason.textContent=(p.intent==='buy'?'You selected the '+p.plan+' plan. Sign up or log in first; checkout is not connected in this demo. ':'')+(p.feature?'Next step: '+p.feature+'. ':'')+'Your selected plan and feature will remain on this browser during sign-up or login.';
    if(chip){chip.hidden=!(p.plan||p.feature);chip.textContent=(p.plan?'Plan: '+p.plan:'')+(p.feature?(p.plan?' · ':'')+p.feature:'');}
    const signup=root.querySelector('#gateSignup'), login=root.querySelector('#gateLogin');
    if(signup) signup.href=routeHref('signup');
    if(login) login.href=routeHref('login');
    updateYears(root);
  }
  function configureAuth(view, route) {
    const root=document.getElementById('view-'+view), p=sharedParams(route);
    const chip=root.querySelector(view==='login'?'#loginPlanChip':'#signupPlanChip');
    if(chip){chip.hidden=!(p.plan||p.feature);chip.textContent=(p.plan?'Selected plan: '+p.plan:'')+(p.feature?' · '+p.feature:'');}
    const switchLink=root.querySelector(view==='login'?'#loginSignupLink':'#signupLoginLink');
    if(switchLink) switchLink.href=routeHref(view==='login'?'signup':'login');
    updateYears(root);
  }
  function configureAccount() {
    const root=document.getElementById('view-account');
    const name=readSession('alleyCloudDemoName','maker'), plan=readSession('alleyCloudDemoPlan','Free');
    const dn=root.querySelector('#dashName'), dp=root.querySelector('#dashPlan');
    if(dn) dn.textContent=name.split(' ')[0]||'maker';
    if(dp) dp.textContent='Selected plan: '+plan+' · Supabase account';
    updateYears(root);
  }

  const featurePageContent = {
    'NANO AI': {
      category:'AI workspace', title:'NANO AI',
      lead:'An AI-powered workspace for questions, planning, writing, coding help, and turning ideas into practical next steps.',
      what:'NANO AI is ALLEY Cloud’s AI assistant experience. You can use it to ask questions, brainstorm, explain concepts, draft content, review code, and work through project problems in one place.',
      audience:'Students, makers, developers, and teams who want an AI assistant alongside their files, websites, and server tools.',
      benefits:['Ask questions and get guided explanations','Brainstorm ideas and plan projects','Get help understanding and writing code','Draft, rewrite, and summarize text','Use a daily AI credit allowance based on your subscription','Keep AI access alongside other ALLEY Cloud tools'],
      how:['Open the NANO AI workspace from your account dashboard.','Enter a prompt or question and send it to the AI service.','The backend securely calls the configured AI provider and returns the response.','Your account’s daily credit allowance is checked by the backend.'],
      needs:['A signed-in ALLEY Cloud account','An active NANO AI subscription or eligible ALLEY Prime access for live usage','A configured AI provider and secure server-side API integration','A published usage and fair-use policy'],
      tierIntro:'NANO AI can be subscribed to on its own or included in ALLEY Prime.'
    },
    'Raspberry Pi Access': {
      category:'Home server connection', title:'Your Raspberry Pi, from anywhere',
      lead:'A secure way to reach and manage your own Raspberry Pi home server while you are away from home.',
      what:'ALLEY Cloud is designed to help you connect to a Raspberry Pi you own and operate at home. The intended service pairs an authenticated connection or tunnel with your account, so you can reach approved services without exposing an unsecured SSH port to the public internet.',
      audience:'Raspberry Pi owners, makers, developers, and home-lab users who want to manage their own hardware remotely.',
      benefits:['Connect to your own Raspberry Pi home server','Use SSH for command-line administration','Use VNC-style remote desktop viewing and control where supported','Remote desktop capability is powered by Raspberry Pi Connect','Manage projects and files on your own device','Keep remote access tied to an authenticated account','Use access controls and SSH keys rather than sharing passwords'],
      how:['Install and configure Raspberry Pi Connect on a compatible Raspberry Pi and sign in to the intended device account.','Pair the device with your ALLEY Cloud account through the secure enrollment flow when that integration is deployed.','The backend checks your account, subscription, and device permissions.','Use SSH for terminal administration and Raspberry Pi Connect for supported remote desktop/screen sharing.'],
      needs:['A Raspberry Pi or compatible Linux device that you own','Reliable home internet and power','A secure connector/tunnel service and device enrollment','SSH keys, firewall rules, and server-side access controls'],
      tierIntro:'The related Linux Server & SSH subscription includes SSH and VNC-style remote desktop access powered by Raspberry Pi Connect. Planned concurrent connection limits are Plus 1, Pro 2, Ultra 3, and Business custom. Your personal Raspberry Pi remains your own hardware.',
      subscriptionKey:'Linux Server & SSH'
    },
    'Website & Domains': {
      category:'Web publishing', title:'Website & Domains',
      lead:'Publish a portfolio, project page, or full website and connect a domain that people can use to reach it.',
      what:'The Website & Domains feature is designed to bring your website projects and domain settings into your ALLEY Cloud account. Depending on the subscription, you can use an included IP/domain endpoint or connect a custom domain to an eligible hosted project.',
      audience:'Creators, developers, small businesses, and anyone who wants a simple place to publish a website or project.',
      benefits:['Organize website projects in one workspace','Publish a portfolio, landing page, or project site','Use an included IP/domain endpoint on eligible tiers','Connect a custom domain on eligible tiers','Review deployment and domain status from your account'],
      how:['Create or upload your website project.','Choose an ALLEY Cloud hosting destination or supported deployment target.','Configure the domain and DNS records for that destination.','Publish the site and verify that the domain points to the live deployment.'],
      needs:['An ALLEY Cloud account and eligible Website & Domains subscription','A website project ready to publish','A registered domain for custom-domain use','A configured hosting, deployment, and DNS backend'],
      tierIntro:'The number of websites, domains, and publishing options depends on the selected tier.'
    },
    'Cloud Storage': {
      category:'File storage', title:'Cloud Storage',
      lead:'Keep documents, project files, backups, and website assets organized in your ALLEY Cloud workspace.',
      what:'Cloud Storage is the file-storage area associated with your ALLEY Cloud account. The subscription tier sets the intended storage quota, while account controls determine who can access each file.',
      audience:'People who work across multiple projects and want their files and website assets available alongside their other ALLEY Cloud tools.',
      benefits:['Store project files and website assets','Keep files associated with your account','Use a storage allowance based on your subscription','Organize project resources in one place','Expand storage by selecting a higher tier or custom Business capacity'],
      how:['Sign in to your ALLEY Cloud account.','Upload files through the storage workspace.','The backend stores files in a private storage bucket and associates them with your user ID.','Downloads and file operations are checked against your account permissions.'],
      needs:['An active Cloud Storage subscription or ALLEY Prime access','A configured private object-storage bucket','Server-side upload/download authorization and quota enforcement','Appropriate file size, retention, and acceptable-use limits'],
      tierIntro:'The listed capacity is the intended storage allocation for each tier.'
    },
    'Linux Server & SSH': {
      category:'Linux hosting', title:'Linux Server, SSH & VNC',
      lead:'Get a Linux server with secure SSH command-line access and VNC-style remote desktop access powered by Raspberry Pi Connect.',
      what:'Each paid Linux Server & SSH subscription is intended to include one Linux server. SSH provides command-line administration, while Raspberry Pi Connect provides supported remote screen sharing and desktop control for compatible Raspberry Pi devices. The planned connection limits count concurrent remote-access sessions, not additional servers.',
      audience:'Developers, students, makers, Raspberry Pi owners, and teams who need terminal and remote desktop access to a Linux environment.',
      benefits:['One Linux server with each paid subscription','Secure command-line access through SSH','VNC-style remote desktop/screen sharing powered by Raspberry Pi Connect where supported','Plus: 1 concurrent SSH/VNC connection','Pro: 2 concurrent SSH/VNC connections','Ultra: 3 concurrent SSH/VNC connections','Business: custom server resources and connection count','SSH keys and account-controlled access'],
      how:['Choose a Linux Server & SSH subscription.','The backend creates or assigns a Linux instance and checks your allowed connection count.','Add an SSH public key and pair a compatible Raspberry Pi with Raspberry Pi Connect where remote desktop is required.','Connect using SSH for terminal tasks or Raspberry Pi Connect for supported screen sharing and desktop control.'],
      needs:['An active paid Linux Server & SSH subscription or ALLEY Prime entitlement','A provisioned Linux server and published resource limits','SSH key setup and secure server configuration','Raspberry Pi Connect configured on compatible Raspberry Pi hardware for its remote desktop capabilities','A backend to create, suspend, monitor, and remove servers and enforce connection limits'],
      tierIntro:'Every paid tier includes one Linux server, SSH, and VNC-style remote desktop powered by Raspberry Pi Connect where supported. Concurrent connections: Plus 1, Pro 2, Ultra 3, Business custom.'
    },
    'Proxy Network': {
      category:'Network service', title:'Proxy Network',
      lead:'Route supported application traffic through an ALLEY Cloud proxy endpoint where your subscription allows it.',
      what:'The Proxy Network feature is designed to provide managed proxy access for legitimate testing, privacy, network integration, and application routing. The service must publish its supported protocols, locations, bandwidth allowances, and acceptable-use rules before launch.',
      audience:'Developers and organizations that need controlled proxy routing for application testing or approved network workflows.',
      benefits:['Use a managed proxy endpoint when provisioned','Choose a tier based on the published capacity','Manage access from your ALLEY Cloud account','Keep proxy credentials separate from your website password','Use documented limits and acceptable-use rules'],
      how:['Choose a Proxy Network subscription.','The backend provisions an endpoint and securely issues access credentials.','Configure your supported application or device to use the endpoint.','Review usage and rotate credentials through your account controls.'],
      needs:['An active Proxy Network subscription or eligible ALLEY Prime access','A deployed proxy service and endpoint inventory','Secure credential issuance and revocation','Published capacity, location, logging, and acceptable-use policies'],
      tierIntro:'Proxy Network is an individual subscription. Its precise capacities and endpoints must be published before launch.'
    },
    'VPN Access': {
      category:'Private networking', title:'VPN Access',
      lead:'Connect a compatible device to an encrypted ALLEY Cloud VPN endpoint for supported private-network workflows.',
      what:'VPN Access is designed to provide an encrypted connection between a device and a managed VPN gateway. Exact protocols, supported devices, locations, bandwidth, and network routes depend on the production VPN service.',
      audience:'Customers who need an encrypted connection to supported private services or networks they are authorized to access.',
      benefits:['Connect through a managed VPN endpoint when provisioned','Protect traffic between your device and the VPN gateway','Manage device access from your ALLEY Cloud account','Use documented device and connection limits','Revoke access for lost or unused devices'],
      how:['Choose a VPN Access subscription.','The backend provisions a VPN profile or device credential.','Install the supported VPN client and import the profile.','Connect to the gateway and manage active devices from your account.'],
      needs:['An active VPN Access subscription or eligible ALLEY Prime access','A deployed VPN gateway and secure profile generation','Device enrollment, credential rotation, and revocation','Published protocols, locations, network routes, and usage limits'],
      tierIntro:'VPN Access is a separate subscription. Its supported protocols and capacities must be defined by the live service.'
    },
    'ALLEY Prime': {
      category:'All-in-one bundle', title:'ALLEY Prime',
      lead:'One subscription that bundles all ALLEY Cloud feature subscriptions into a single package.',
      what:'ALLEY Prime is the all-features subscription bundle. It is designed to include NANO AI, Cloud Storage, Website & Domains, Linux Server & SSH, Proxy Network, and VPN Access in one account package.',
      audience:'Customers who want the complete ALLEY Cloud feature set without selecting each individual feature separately.',
      benefits:['Pro-level NANO AI: 1,500 credits per day','Pro-level Cloud Storage: 128 GB','Website and domain features including 1 custom domain','One Linux server with SSH and Raspberry Pi Connect VNC-style remote desktop','2 concurrent SSH/VNC connections','Pro Proxy and Pro VPN subscriptions','One subscription covering every Pro-level ALLEY Cloud feature'],
      how:['Choose monthly or yearly ALLEY Prime billing.','Complete checkout when payment processing is connected.','The backend applies the Prime entitlements to your account.','Manage the included services from the ALLEY Cloud dashboard.'],
      needs:['An ALLEY Cloud account','A Prime subscription or verified entitlement','A connected payment and subscription-management backend','Production provisioning for AI, storage, hosting, Linux, Proxy, and VPN services'],
      tierIntro:'ALLEY Prime includes the Pro level of every feature, not Ultra: 1,500 NANO AI credits/day, 128 GB storage, 1 custom domain, one Linux server with SSH and Raspberry Pi Connect remote desktop (2 concurrent connections), Pro Proxy, and Pro VPN. Choose $50/month or $500/year.',
      prime:true
    }
  };

  function configureFeature(route) {
    const root = document.getElementById('view-feature');
    if (!root) return;
    const requested = safe(route.params.get('feature') || 'NANO AI', 80);
    const data = featurePageContent[requested] || featurePageContent['NANO AI'];
    const set = (id, value) => { const el=root.querySelector('#'+id); if(el) el.textContent=value; };
    set('featureDetailCategory', data.category);
    set('featureDetailTitle', data.title);
    set('featureDetailLead', data.lead);
    set('featureDetailWhat', data.what);
    set('featureDetailAudience', data.audience);
    set('featureDetailTierIntro', data.tierIntro);
    set('featureDetailDisclaimer', 'Availability note: these pages describe the planned ALLEY Cloud service. Live AI requests, file storage, domains, server provisioning, Proxy, VPN, usage enforcement, and paid entitlements only work after their production services are deployed and connected.');
    const fillList = (id, items, className) => {
      const el=root.querySelector('#'+id); if(!el) return;
      el.replaceChildren();
      items.forEach(text => { const li=document.createElement('li'); li.textContent=text; el.appendChild(li); });
    };
    fillList('featureDetailBenefits', data.benefits);
    fillList('featureDetailHow', data.how);
    fillList('featureDetailNeeds', data.needs);
    const tierGrid=root.querySelector('#featureDetailTiers');
    if(!tierGrid) return;
    tierGrid.replaceChildren();
    const addTier=(tier,price,period,summary,onChoose)=>{
      const button=document.createElement('button');
      button.type='button'; button.className='feature-tier-card';
      const name=document.createElement('strong'); name.textContent=tier;
      const cost=document.createElement('span'); cost.className='feature-tier-price'; cost.append(document.createTextNode(price+' '));
      const small=document.createElement('small'); small.textContent=period; cost.appendChild(small);
      const desc=document.createElement('span'); desc.textContent=summary;
      const action=document.createElement('em'); action.textContent='View details →';
      button.append(name,cost,desc,action);
      button.addEventListener('click',onChoose);
      tierGrid.appendChild(button);
    };
    if (data.prime) {
      addTier('Monthly','$50','/ month','All ALLEY Cloud features, billed monthly.',()=>openSubscriptionDetails('ALLEY Prime','Prime','monthly'));
      addTier('Yearly','$500','/ year','All ALLEY Cloud features. Save $100 annually.',()=>openSubscriptionDetails('ALLEY Prime','Prime','yearly'));
    } else {
      const subKey=data.subscriptionKey || data.title;
      const tierData=featureSubscriptionData[subKey];
      if(tierData){
        Object.entries(tierData).forEach(([tier,info])=>{
          const summary=(info.features||[]).slice(0,2).join(' · ');
          addTier(tier,info.price,info.period,summary,()=>openSubscriptionDetails(subKey,tier));
        });
      } else {
        const note=document.createElement('p'); note.textContent='Subscription pricing is being prepared.'; tierGrid.appendChild(note);
      }
    }
  }

  function render() {
    const route=getRoute();
    if(route.view==='account' && readSession('alleyCloudDemoSignedIn')!=='1') { go('gate',{intent:'dashboard'},true); return; }
    document.querySelectorAll('.spa-view').forEach(v=>v.classList.toggle('active',v.dataset.view===route.view));
    document.title = ({home:'ALLEY Cloud — Your AI. Your Pi. Your corner of the web.',login:'Log in | ALLEY Cloud',signup:'Create an account | ALLEY Cloud',account:'Your workspace | ALLEY Cloud',gate:'Account required | ALLEY Cloud',feature:'Feature details | ALLEY Cloud'})[route.view] || 'ALLEY Cloud';
    if(route.view==='gate') configureGate(route);
    if(route.view==='feature') configureFeature(route);
    if(route.view==='login'||route.view==='signup') configureAuth(route.view,route);
    if(route.view==='account') configureAccount();
    if(route.view==='home') updateYears(document.getElementById('view-home'));
    window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'auto'});
    if(route.view==='home') {
      const target=route.scroll || route.params.get('scroll');
      if(target && target!=='home') requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const el=document.getElementById(target); if(el) el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});});
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener('hashchange',render);
  // Clicking a feature card or service card opens a dedicated detail page.
  document.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const card = event.target.closest('[data-feature-detail]');
    if (!card) return;
    if (event.target.closest('[data-subscription-option]')) return;
    if (event.target.closest('button:not([data-feature-detail])')) return;
    const feature = card.getAttribute('data-feature-detail');
    if (!feature) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    go('feature', {feature});
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    const card = event.target.closest('[data-feature-detail][role="link"]');
    if (!card || (event.key !== 'Enter' && event.key !== ' ')) return;
    if (event.target !== card) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    go('feature', {feature:card.getAttribute('data-feature-detail')});
  });
  document.addEventListener('click',event=>{
    if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
    const link=event.target.closest('a[href]');
    if(!link) return;
    const href=link.getAttribute('href')||'';
    if(href.startsWith('#/')) { event.preventDefault(); location.hash=href.slice(1); return; }
    const route=getRoute();
    if(route.view==='home' && link.matches('[data-auth-gate]')) { event.preventDefault(); const u=new URL(link.href,location.href); const fileQ=href.includes('?')?href.split('?')[1]:''; const p=new URLSearchParams(fileQ); go('gate',{intent:p.get('intent')||'learn',plan:p.get('plan')||'Free',feature:p.get('feature')||''}); }
  });

  // Home-page behavior: interactive previews are demos; gated actions request an account.
  const home=document.getElementById('view-home');
  const toast=home.querySelector('#toast'); let toastTimer;
  function notify(message){ if(!toast) return; toast.innerHTML=message; toast.classList.add('show'); clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('show'),4200); }

  // Plan details dialog: selecting a card opens a full feature list before signup/upgrade.
  const planDetailModal = home.querySelector('#planDetailsModal');
  const planDetailTitle = home.querySelector('#planDetailTitle');
  const planDetailDescription = home.querySelector('#planDetailDescription');
  const planDetailPrice = home.querySelector('#planDetailPrice');
  const planDetailFeatures = home.querySelector('#planDetailFeatures');
  const planDetailNote = home.querySelector('#planDetailNote');
  const planDetailContinue = home.querySelector('#planDetailContinue');
  const planDetailCloseButtons = planDetailModal ? planDetailModal.querySelectorAll('[data-plan-detail-close]') : [];
  let planDetailLastFocus = null;
  let activePlanDetail = 'Plus';
  const planDetailData = {
    Free: {
      price: '$0', period: 'forever',
      description: 'Free is a safe way to explore the ALLEY Cloud experience. It is demo-only and does not provision paid services.',
      features: ['NANO AI chat with sample demo responses', 'Simulated SSH terminal, not connected to a real server', 'Preview of website and domain tools', 'Sample account dashboard', 'No live AI credits, proxy, VPN, Linux server, or production hosting'],
      note: 'Free is a demo plan only. The AI chat, terminal, domains, and hosting previews do not activate live infrastructure.',
      action: 'Start with Free demo'
    },
    Plus: {
      price: '$5', period: 'per month',
      description: 'For everyday projects: daily NANO AI credits, roomy cloud storage, a domain endpoint, and your own Linux server.',
      features: ['500 NANO AI credits per day', '1 included IP/domain endpoint', '64 GB Cloud Storage', 'Website project and publishing tools', '1 Linux server with SSH access', 'VNC-style remote desktop powered by Raspberry Pi Connect', '1 concurrent SSH/VNC connection', 'Optional standalone Proxy for $1/month and VPN for $1/month'],
      note: 'Server access, AI quotas, storage and domain routing are planned entitlements. They become real only after ALLEY Cloud backend services are deployed.',
      action: 'Continue with Plus'
    },
    Pro: {
      price: '$10', period: 'per month',
      description: 'Everything in Plus with higher daily AI capacity, more storage, a custom domain, and Proxy/VPN features.',
      features: ['Everything in Plus, upgraded to 1,500 NANO AI credits per day', '128 GB Cloud Storage', '1 custom domain', 'Pro Proxy for $3/month', 'Pro VPN for $3/month', '1 Linux server with SSH access', 'VNC-style remote desktop powered by Raspberry Pi Connect', '2 concurrent SSH/VNC connections', 'Advanced project tools and priority support'],
      note: 'Proxy, VPN, server provisioning, domain setup and usage enforcement must be connected to real infrastructure; this static website is only a concept/demo.',
      action: 'Continue with Pro'
    },
    Ultra: {
      price: '$25', period: 'per month',
      description: 'The highest individual tier: everything in Pro, with 1 TB storage, infinite daily NANO AI credits, and advanced tools.',
      features: ['Everything in Pro', 'Infinite NANO AI credits per day*', '1 TB Cloud Storage', '1 custom domain', 'Ultra Proxy for $5/month', 'Ultra VPN for $5/month', '1 Linux server with SSH access', 'VNC-style remote desktop powered by Raspberry Pi Connect', '3 concurrent SSH/VNC connections', 'Priority project queue and usage/activity logs', 'More room for larger projects and demanding workflows'],
      note: '*“Infinite” is the intended plan description. A live service still needs model/provider capacity, abuse prevention, and a clear fair-use policy.',
      action: 'Continue with Ultra'
    },
    Business: {
      price: '$5–$100+', period: 'customizable monthly pricing',
      description: 'Build a custom package by choosing AI capacity, storage, website projects, team features and support.',
      features: ['Choose add-ons to match your team and workload', 'Flexible AI capacity and cloud storage', 'Optional more websites and Raspberry Pi connections', 'Optional team seats, priority support and dedicated deployment', '1 Linux server with SSH access', 'Starting at $5/month; configurations over $100/month need a custom quote', 'Proxy and VPN can be added as separately priced Business options; they are not automatically bundled'],
      note: 'Use Customize Business to calculate an illustrative price. The estimate is not a contract or charge, and paid services require backend setup.',
      action: 'Customize Business plan'
    }
  };
  // Standalone subscriptions: each feature can be selected at Plus, Pro, Ultra, or Business level.
  let activeSubscription = null;
  let businessFeatureContext = '';
  const featureSubscriptionData = {
    'NANO AI': {
      Plus: {price:'$5',period:'per month',features:['500 NANO AI credits per day','Access to the NANO AI workspace','Basic prompt and project assistance'],description:'A standalone NANO AI subscription for everyday questions and projects.'},
      Pro: {price:'$10',period:'per month',features:['1,500 NANO AI credits per day','Everything in the Plus AI tier','Higher daily usage allowance'],description:'More daily NANO AI capacity for regular building and development work.'},

      Pro: {price:'$10',period:'per month',features:['1 Linux server','SSH command-line access','VNC-style remote desktop powered by Raspberry Pi Connect where supported','2 concurrent SSH/VNC connections','Pro-tier server resource allocation'],description:'A Pro Linux server subscription with two concurrent SSH/VNC connections.'},
